emulator_policy.flag_capture: Manhattan radius 2, living soldiers only. One present side takes a neutral flag; an enemy-owned flag becomes neutral first and is taken on its next accepted capture update. Both sides or neither side preserve the previous owner. Explicit server policy.
emulator_policy.flag_score_clock: One 4/10/18 OF award per team at completion of a full round of the living owners among the eight originally admitted accounts; dead/escaped slots are skipped. This clock/radius policy is not recovered from the original announcement.
emulator_policy.schedule: Weekly UTC windows, three hours apart; published server schedule, not a recovered original timetable.
emulator_policy.ratio_table: Conservative step lookup in thousandths; missing original table. Anchors: 0%=-2 OV, 44.9%=4 OV, 55.1%=10 OV, 100%=16 OV.
emulator_policy.capture: Highest positive event OV among clans in an actual opposing-coalition battle with damage, kills or flag activity. Tie retains current owner if tied, else smallest clan ID; no contested positive score means no capture.
emulator_policy.influence: One positive net event OV award, floor(half-OV units/2), at finalization; no credit/Gold prize or historical capture bonus is inferred.
emulator_policy.late_matches: Already bound matches may settle after a tour ends. No new pair after tour end; finalization waits for every bound match. Closed events reject new results.
